# Appendix F. Research data, provenance and access

## F1. Frozen input data

The [versioned Agrologistic v0.2.0 record](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22751909)
contains the historical input archive. Appendix D identifies the workbooks,
their SHA-256 digests, the warehouse populations and the directed OSRM
distances used for each model size. Cite the version DOI and match the
workbook digest to the experimental record before comparing results.
The terms applicable to the original registry and OpenStreetMap-derived
road data are documented separately from the software licence.

## F2. National investment summaries

The proposed companion dataset contains national summaries of candidate
opening, existing-site expansion and bulk-handling conversion. It contains
11 case–decision rows across eight configurations. The data dictionary
distinguishes the binary activation count from modeled capacity in metric
tonnes. Each value can be recomputed from the corresponding GitHub investment
list. The package documents coverage, source identities, field definitions,
licence scope and checksums.

The companion dataset has been prepared and verified locally and is
awaiting deposit. The v0.2.0 DOI identifies the historical inputs.
The GitHub investment lists provide the source values for the
national summaries.

## F3. Full-resolution outputs

The full positive-flow tables, endpoint-level distance exports, selected
graphs and SQLite companions are outside the proposed deposit. The
national investment summaries support verification of those totals.
Exact numerical reproduction uses the input, network, model and execution
records identified in Appendices C–E. The release documentation records
access and rights by asset. Full-resolution transfers depend on the
applicable third-party terms and disclosure review.
